checkpoints.name: budget_agnostic_strategy_exists
checkpoints.description: Theorem 27 of Avni-Sadhukhan (arXiv 2509.00506v1): there is a legal budget-agnostic Pres strategy that M-wins from every configuration <v,B> with B >= Th(v), with M = (k+1)*(W + max_v Energy(v,Th(v))) explicit. Determinacy of reachability discrete-bidding games (Develin-Payne 2010; Aghajohari-Avni-Henzinger 2021) is taken as the hypothesis hdet.
